name: Chattrn – Live Chat and AI Agent Plugin for WP Websites
author: Chattrn

sections.description:
Chattrn is an AI-powered customer support omnichannel platform designed to deliver seamless customer support experience for WooCommerce and WordPress websites.

Whether you’re running a busy e-commerce store, SaaS company, healthcare provider, or agency with multiple customers, AI Chatbot, Live Chat, Omnichannel Inbox, and Customer Support Agent for WP environment.

Install the plugin in WordPress, log in to your account, and start handling customer inquiries with no coding required.

Why Live Chat?

Deliver exceptional support experience and build customer relationships with live support features:

  • Omnichannel support (Connect your knowledge base)
  • Live Chat with real-time visitor list & conversations
  • Real-time typing status of who’s typing
  • Unlimited messages & conversations
  • Smart contact messaging
  • Pre-made chat button
  • AI Agent
  • Smart Chat routing
  • AI Knowledge base
  • Customer Environment
  • Visitor Information with conversation history
  • Responded in minutes
  • Rich ecosystem chat widget
  • Serverless mobile cloud platform

Why Chattrn?

Deliver exceptional customer experiences with AI Agent. AI-powered live support platform:

  • AI Chatbot: powered by your knowledge base
  • Live Chat: real-time visitor conversations
  • Human agent & AI agent hybrid support
  • Unified inbox for all communications
  • Omnichannel messaging
  • No-code platform builder
  • AI Agent
  • Smart Chat routing
  • AI Knowledge base
  • Visitor Information with conversation history
  • Responsive chat widget
  • Rich ecosystem chat widget
  • Serverless mobile cloud platform

AI Knowledge Base

Educate AI chatbot with customer data:
Train AI on custom documentation:

  • Website content
  • Documents & files
  • Documentation
  • FAQs
  • Upload files & intelligence AI

Live Chat

Provide real-time support to customers across your WordPress site:

  • Real-time chat
  • Typing indicators
  • Live tracking
  • Conversation history
  • Multiple agents
  • Real-time notification

Unified Inbox

Manage customer messages from multiple platforms in one place:
Support multiple channels:

  • Website Live Chat
  • Facebook Messenger
  • Instagram
  • WhatsApp

No more switching between multiple apps.

No-Code Agent Builder

Create customized conversational AI flows with drag-and-drop builder:

  • Drag-and-drop
  • FAQs
  • Escalation support
  • Qualification forms
  • Support form & more

Widget Customization

Match your brand identity:

  • Brand logo
  • Colors
  • Greeting message
  • Welcome message
  • Position
  • Language
  • Launcher Icon

Chat Routing

Automatically assign chats to available agents based on:

  • Department routing
  • Skill-based routing
  • Priority assignment
  • Round-robin routing
  • Intelligent auto-assignment

Customer Information

Learn more about customer experience:

  • Visitor Details
  • Previous conversations
  • Customer location
  • Custom metadata
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Chattrn”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Settings → Chattrn and log in with your Chattrn account to connect your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Chattrn account?

Yes, you need a Chattrn account to use the plugin. Sign up at https://www.chattrn.com if you don’t already have one.

Is Chattrn free?

Yes, the plugin is free to download and use on your WordPress site, with options for premium plans depending on your usage.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Yes, Chattrn offers full branding, welcome messages, and colors to match your WordPress site style.

Does it support AI?

Yes, Chattrn has built-in AI support to respond using your knowledge base and auto escalations.

Can I manage multiple permissions?

Effortlessly, create agents for team members and set permissions at any time.

Is it mobile compatible?

Yes. The widget and dashboard work seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
